name: Vape hardware and aerosol emissions
reason: The consumable (cartridge fill / vape oil) is compiled separately on the inhaled-route total-content basis (see subcategory cannabis-vape-cartridge-fill). What remains reserved is metal RELEASE from the device heating element into the inhaled aerosol (coil leaching of Pb, Ni, and Cr) and the aerosol-emission behaviour of the heated oil — a different measured quantity (mass emitted, not total content). A ug/kg product-content limit cannot express it. The aerosol-emissions test architecture — and whether hardware is factored per-category here or under one shared inhalable-hardware treatment with nicotine vapes — is a reserved governance decision for Karen (docs/governance/taxonomy-reorganization-2026-06.md section 4; category-25-step0-lock.md). No emissions standard is set until that architecture is locked.
governing_basis_when_unreserved: aerosol-emissions basis (mass emitted per puff or per gram aerosolized), not product-content ug/kg; Pb/Ni/Cr released from the heating element are the primary analytes.
